POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Master DB password referenced by all services. Must be non-empty.

JWT_SECRET.description: HS256 key that signs ANON_KEY and SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

ANON_KEY.description: Public client API key — JWT signed by JWT_SECRET. View in supabase.com/docs/guides/self-hosting#api-keys

SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Server-side key with full access. JWT signed by JWT_SECRET.

DASHBOARD_USERNAME.description: Username for any admin dashboard access (if Studio were included)

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.description: Password for admin dashboard access. Auto-generated secret.
